responsibility: Cross-platform Ctrl-C interception support for GNAT tools and runtime code. It installs and removes a process-wide interrupt handler using POSIX sigaction or Windows console control handlers, preserves the original handler for restoration, and includes special VMS handling that defers execution through a global callback hook. This is the dedicated SIGINT/Ctrl-Break management layer, not the general synchronous-fault mapping handled in init.c or seh_init.c.
